title: Dash Cam 1080p with 3-Inch Screen, Night Vision and G-Sensor
description:
A compact windscreen camera that records your journeys automatically, so you have clear footage if something happens on the road.
• Full HD 1080p recording with 170° wide-angle lens and night vision
• 3-inch screen for easy playback and settings
• Loop recording replaces the oldest files; G-sensor locks clips after a bump
• Parking monitor wakes the camera if the car is knocked
• Suction mount and 3.5 m 12/24 V power cable included; microSD card up to 128 GB not included; check local rules on dash cam use

title: 7-Inch 2-DIN Touchscreen Car Stereo with Bluetooth and Reversing Camera
description:
Upgrade an older car with a large touchscreen for hands-free calls, music streaming and a clear rear view when parking.
• 7-inch HD touchscreen in standard 2-DIN size (178 × 100 mm)
• Bluetooth hands-free calling and music streaming; FM radio with 18 presets
• USB and microSD playback, AUX input and steering-wheel control support
• Reversing camera with night vision included, switches on automatically in reverse
• 4 × 50 W max output; ISO wiring harness and remote control included

title: 7-Inch Portable Car Display with Wireless Phone Mirroring and Bluetooth
description:
A dashboard touchscreen that brings navigation, music and calls from your phone to a bigger, easier-to-see screen, without changing the car radio.
• 7-inch IPS touchscreen, 1024 × 600 resolution
• Wireless and wired screen mirroring for most smartphones
• Bluetooth hands-free calls; sound through the built-in speaker, AUX cable or FM transmitter
• Plugs into the 12/24 V socket; suction and dashboard mounts included
• Voice control through your phone's assistant

title: 6.5-Inch Coaxial Car Speakers, 2-Way, 160 W Max, Pair
description:
Replacement door speakers with clearer highs and fuller bass than worn-out factory speakers, in a standard size that fits many cars.
• 165 mm (6.5-inch) 2-way coaxial design with built-in tweeter
• 160 W max / 40 W RMS per speaker, 4 Ω
• Polypropylene cone with rubber surround for long life
• Mounting depth 55 mm; grilles, screws and cables included
• Supplied as a pair

title: Car Air Freshener Diffuser with 3 Scent Refills and Vent Clip
description:
Keep your car smelling fresh with a slow-release liquid diffuser that clips onto an air vent or hangs from the mirror.
• Aluminium and glass diffuser with adjustable flow
• 3 × 8 ml scent refills, each lasting up to 30 days
• Vent clip and hanging cord both included
• Keep out of reach of children; avoid spills on dashboard plastics

title: Universal Car Seat Cover Set for 5 Seats, Padded, Side-Airbag Friendly
description:
Protect your seats from wear, spills and pet hair with a full set of padded covers that fits most cars.
• Full set: 2 front seat covers, split rear bench cover (40/60) and 5 headrest covers
• Breathable polyester with 5 mm foam padding
• Tear-away seams for side airbags built into the seats
• Elastic straps and hooks for quick fitting
• Machine washable at 30 °C

title: Steering Wheel Cover 37–38 cm, Microfibre Leather, Non-Slip Grip
description:
A soft, grippy cover that refreshes a worn steering wheel and stays comfortable in summer heat and winter cold.
• Fits steering wheels 37–38 cm in diameter
• Microfibre leather with breathable perforated grip zones
• Non-slip rubber inner ring keeps it from twisting
• Stretches on in a few minutes, no tools needed

title: Waterproof Full Car Cover with UV and Snow Protection, Sizes S–XL
description:
A full-size outdoor car cover that keeps rain, snow, dust, bird droppings and strong sun off your paintwork.
• Multi-layer PEVA-coated polyester with a soft cotton-feel lining
• Waterproof and UV-resistant, with elastic hem and underbody straps
• Driver-side zip for door access, plus mirror pockets
• Reflective strips for visibility at night
• Storage bag included; choose the size by your car's length

title: 2-in-1 Ice Scraper and Snow Brush, Extendable 65–90 cm
description:
Clear snow and ice from windscreens and roofs quickly, with enough reach for SUVs and vans.
• Extends from 65 to 90 cm
• Wide snow brush with soft bristles that won't scratch the paint
• Tough scraper blade with ice-breaking teeth
• Foam grip stays comfortable in freezing temperatures

title: Microfibre Car Cleaning Cloths, 12-Pack, 40 × 40 cm, 350 GSM
description:
Soft, absorbent cloths for washing, drying, polishing and interior cleaning, gentle on paint, glass and screens.
• 12 cloths, 40 × 40 cm, 350 GSM split microfibre
• Edgeless design helps avoid scratches
• Absorbs several times its own weight in water
• Machine washable at 40 °C; do not use fabric softener

title: Car Wash Kit with Foam Sprayer, Wash Mitt, Sponge and Drying Towel
description:
Everything you need for a careful hand wash at home, from thick pre-wash foam to a streak-free dry.
• 1 L pump foam sprayer with adjustable nozzle
• Chenille microfibre wash mitt and wheel sponge
• Large waffle-weave drying towel, 60 × 90 cm
• Storage bag included; car shampoo not included

title: Car Detailing Brush Set, 5 Soft Brushes for Interior, Vents and Wheels
description:
Reach into air vents, seams, badges and wheel spokes that cloths can't get to, without scratching delicate surfaces.
• 5 brushes in different sizes with soft synthetic bristles
• No exposed metal, so they are safe on dashboards, screens and paint
• Comfortable plastic handles with hanging loops
• Simply rinse with water after use

title: Cordless Tyre Inflator with Digital Gauge, 150 PSI, Auto Stop
description:
A rechargeable pocket compressor that tops up car, bike and motorbike tyres anywhere, stopping automatically at the pressure you set.
• Up to 150 PSI (10.3 bar) with a clear digital display
• Set the target in PSI, bar, kPa or kg/cm²; stops automatically when reached
• Built-in 4000 mAh battery charges via USB-C; built-in LED light
• Includes bike valve adapter, ball needle and storage pouch
• Takes a typical car tyre from 2.0 to 2.5 bar in about 3 minutes

title: Car Jump Leads 3.5 m, 600 A, with Fully Insulated Clamps
description:
Heavy-duty jump leads for starting a car with a flat battery from another vehicle, long enough to reach between two cars.
• 3.5 m cables rated up to 600 A
• For petrol engines up to 3.0 L and diesel engines up to 2.5 L
• Fully insulated, colour-coded red and black clamps with strong springs
• Storage bag with printed instructions included

title: Smart Car Battery Charger 6 A, 12 V, with Maintenance Mode, EU Plug
description:
Charges and maintains car, motorbike and ride-on mower batteries automatically, ideal for vehicles that stand unused over winter.
• For 12 V lead-acid, AGM and gel batteries from 4 to 120 Ah
• 7-stage automatic charging with maintenance mode
• LCD shows voltage, current and charge level
• Reverse polarity, short-circuit and overheat protection
• EU plug; crocodile clips and ring terminals included

title: USB RGB Car Interior Ambient Light Strips, 4 × 22 cm, App Control
description:
Add soft coloured lighting to your car's footwells and seats, with colours you set from your phone or that pulse along to music.
• 4 LED strips, 22 cm each, with adhesive backing
• 16 million colours, brightness control and built-in microphone for music sync
• Controlled by app or the included remote
• Plugs into a USB port; for interior use only
• Keep brightness low while driving and follow local rules

title: USB Star Projector Light for Car Roof, Plug and Play
description:
A tiny USB light that projects a starry-sky pattern onto the car ceiling for a relaxing atmosphere.
• Plug-and-play USB-A, no wiring or app needed
• Rotating head to aim the star pattern
• Sound-activated flicker mode
• Just 4 × 2 cm; also works with laptops and power banks
• Use while parked or for passengers so it never distracts the driver

title: Rechargeable LED Work Light Torch with Magnetic Base and Hook
description:
A bright, hands-free light for engine bays, tyre changes and roadside stops: stick it to the car with the magnet or hang it from the hook.
• Up to 800 lumens with main beam, side flood light and red warning flash
• Magnetic base and fold-out hook; head rotates 180°
• Built-in 2000 mAh battery charges via USB-C, up to 6 hours on low
• IPX4 splash-proof aluminium body

title: Waterproof Motorcycle Cover with Lock Holes and Heat-Resistant Panel
description:
Keeps your motorbike or scooter dry, clean and out of the sun when parked outdoors or in the garage.
• 210D Oxford polyester with waterproof coating and a heat-resistant panel near the exhaust
• Elastic hem and buckle strap stop it blowing off in the wind
• Reinforced lock holes at the front and rear wheels
• Reflective strips; storage bag included

title: Motorcycle Saddlebags, Pair, Water-Resistant PU Leather, 2 × 13 L
description:
Classic-look throw-over saddlebags that add storage for touring, commuting and weekend rides.
• 2 × 13 L capacity, each bag 35 × 28 × 13 cm
• Water-resistant PU leather with quick-release buckles
• Adjustable connecting straps fit most motorcycles with a rear seat
• Rain covers included
• Keep clear of the exhaust and check the fit before riding
